notes: editor.md: every preset and lane shape at a window of D seconds and a beat of beatSec (null: beat match Off) → the curves both engines play (plan.schema.json curves; seconds from the window start). windows: a saved position (override.schema.json $defs.position) on a song grid {downbeatSec, beatSec} → song seconds. expect null: the override is refused (Auto plays). plans: an override (pick) on two steady songs {bpm, sec, downbeatSec} (every beat sure, flat energy, intro 0, outro 20 s before the end), planned at pos with earliest = pos + 4.5 s (a fixture input every runner passes as given, not the platform's own lead: editor.md §6) on Automix engine 2 (Classic) or 3 (v2) → the window played and glide (the plan carries one) and kickLock (Automix v2 only, kickLockAllowed: may its kick lock move the mix-in). An override with a speed (spotify-mixes.md rule 10) is planned with that speed, and its expect adds outRate, rate, speedOut and speedIn.

curves.name: slam, 2 bars at 128 BPM: the cut ramp is 8 ms
smooth with beat match off: the swap is 2% of the window either side
auto: the planner keeps its own curves
loop: the loop mix keeps its own curves
custom with an unknown shape: refused

windows.name: a re-analysis moved the grid 20 ms: the bar holds
a re-analysis moved the grid half a bar: the saved seconds snap to the new grid
a re-analysis changed the tempo: the saved seconds snap to the new grid
no grid (beat match off or a weak grid): the saved seconds as they are

plans.name: Slam with beat match Off: the pair's own length (no preset sets one)
Off with 8 bars: songs at their own speed
a preset with no window: the kick lock may move the mix-in

warnings: no intro in the next song to blend over

plans.name: a saved window: played where saved, the kick lock leaves the mix-in
a saved mix-out past the end: back onto the last downbeat that fits

warnings: the mix-out moved to 182.4 s (too close to the end)

plans.name: a saved mix-out already played: the planner's own

warnings: the mix-out at 4.4 s has already played: Auto's mix-out instead

plans.name: Glide on Classic: the plan carries the glide
a Filter pick from before the editor with a saved window: the window is said to be unused

warnings: a Filter mix places itself: the saved window isn't used (pick a preset to use it)

plans.name: a length alone on a pair with no intro (v2): Automix's drop-in, at the length picked (ruled 2026-11-26: a length picked is kept)
songs at a speed (BUDGET #5, Stay x0.97057 -> Cold Water x1.03228, BitChord's BPMs): 10% apart raw, 3.4% as they play, so it beat-matches; B at A's played tempo

warnings: no intro in the next song to blend over

plans.name: the same pair with no speeds: 10% apart, no beat match

warnings: tempos 10% apart (v2 stretches at most 8%): plays without beat match

draw._about: editor.md §10. fn pointCurves: the drawn lanes at a window of D seconds (null: the glide's own length) and a beat of beatSec (the mix's seconds per beat of A), or the glide's steps -> plan curves {out, in}. presetCurves: an override mixing drawn and named lanes. normalizeOverride: an override as saved (count: the number of points kept per deck). shapeDrawing: a named shape as the drawing Draw starts from. plan: the drawn override on two steady songs (as the plans group), with the plan's gain curves and its rate.

draw.name: a step plays as an 8 ms ramp
beats to seconds: x times the mix's beat (125 BPM, 4 bars)
beats to seconds under Glide: each beat its own length (q 1.1, 2 bars)
a drawing longer than the window is cut, the value at D its last point (Hz geometric)
a drawing shorter than the window holds its last value
a curve whose first point is past the window: its first value held
drawn volume with a named EQ shape (centerBassSwap) and no effect
the stutter: 20 gates in 16 bars at 133 BPM, each step an 8 ms ramp
saved: x and values rounded and clamped, sorted, ties kept in drawn order
saved: a third point at one x is dropped; an effect drawing with no curve is none
saved: past 128 points the rest are dropped
refused: a volume drawing with a deck empty (custom is dropped, Auto plays)
refused: a drawing without a unit
Draw starts from the shape: centerCut read back as a step at beat 8 (125 BPM, 4 bars)
Draw starts from the shape: lpBoth in beats
half time (Cinderella 65 -> Drowning 129 BPM, 8 bars): x on A's grid, B's beats two per x
